old: Mihail Makarovitch was not very efficient at his work, though he did it no worse than many others. To put it plainly, he was a man of rather limited education. He could not always be trusted to know where his official powers ended. He didn’t exactly fail to understand certain reforms of the present reign. Rather, he made glaring blunders when he applied them. This wasn’t because he was especially dull. He was careless, and always too hurried to look into the matter properly.
